how: Sydney Bowmen Archery Club (Coogee) runs a two-hour introductory session for newcomers with equipment provided, and Sydney Community College and Northern Archers of Sydney run multi-week beginner courses.
Auskick junior programs and AFL Sydney club football (for example Balmain, Newtown, Glebe) operate across the metro, with the Sydney Swans as the local AFL team.
venue: AFL Sydney clubs (Balmain AFC, Birchgrove Oval)

how: Dedicated bouldering gyms include BlocHaus (Marrickville), 9Degrees (Alexandria) and NOMAD (Annandale), with beginner courses and shoe rental.
Sydney Indoor Climbing Gym (St Peters) and Edge Rock Climbing Centre (Castle Hill, 100+ top-rope routes) offer belay inductions, courses and gear rental.
Sydney Park has a skate park and BMX-friendly zones plus a kids bike track; private BMX lessons run at indoor skate parks.
Sydney Park skate park has zones for all abilities and has hosted free beginner skateboarding lessons in school holidays; many council skate parks exist.
Several schools run classes, including Capoeira Angola ECAMAR (Redfern), Capoeira Bondi, ABADA-Capoeira (Five Dock, Penrith) and Capoeira Topazio.
Cricket NSW runs social and indoor cricket and indoor net hire at Cricket Central (Sydney Olympic Park); The Rec Club (Miranda) runs social indoor cricket, and many suburban clubs play in summer.
Macquarie Ice Rink is open seven days for walk-in public sessions with skate hire, plus a Learn to Skate program and drop-in lessons; Ice Zoo and Liverpool Catholic Club also have rinks.
The Sydney Bears (Ice Hockey NSW) play out of Macquarie Ice Rink, which schedules ice hockey sessions; junior and senior divisions run through Ice Hockey NSW.
The Pickleball Association of NSW lists regular club and social sessions across Sydney (Blacktown, Crows Nest, Menai, The Ponds) and describes the sport as suitable for all levels.
Judo NSW publishes a club locator and directory of judo clubs across Sydney and a "Play Judo" registration for newcomers.
No bobsleigh or skeleton track exists in Australia; the nearest tracks are in the northern hemisphere (e.g. Lake Placid, USA; Nagano, Japan).
Sydney University Football Club (Camperdown) fields teams in the Shute Shield club competition, and suburban clubs across Sydney run community rugby union.
Sydney Observatory (Millers Point, run by Powerhouse) offers guided tours and night photography workshops Wednesday to Sunday; amateur astronomy societies also hold public viewing nights.
Sydney Harbour Kayaks at Spit Bridge (Mosman) rents sea kayaks and runs eco, sunrise and sunset tours, with free intro and safety lessons for beginners.
Sydney Rowing Club at Abbotsford Point on the Parramatta River (est. 1870) is a long-established club; other Sydney clubs run learn-to-row programs.
Royal National Park has 25 listed walking tracks including the Coast Track, about an hour south of the CBD, with a visitor centre and day entry fee.
Bonnie Vale and Uloola Falls campgrounds in Royal National Park are bookable through NSW National Parks.
venue: Bonnie Vale Campground, Royal National Park

how: Royal National Park lists fishing options, and Sydney Harbour and the beaches allow recreational saltwater fishing under a NSW licence regime.
City of Sydney lists community gardens (Glebe, Newtown, Ultimo) where members tend shared or individual beds; allotment-style plots are limited and the page does not say how to get one.
Pro Dive runs open-water courses and gear hire from dive centres in St Peters and Manly, with shore dives in Sydney harbour and coastal sites.
Sydney Community College runs a 6-week hand-building course in Rozelle and hand-building workshops at Silky Shapes Studio in Willoughby.
venue: Sydney Community College (Rozelle) / Silky Shapes Studio

how: An 8-week wheel-throwing course for beginners runs at Silky Shapes Studio, Willoughby, via Sydney Community College, with many start dates.
Sydney Community College runs beginner photography courses and one-day workshops in Rozelle; the Sydney Photography Community also meets on Meetup.
Sydney Community College offers a videography course (DSLR and mirrorless) in Rozelle and an online video editing and production course.
Sydney Community College runs a six-session beginners Life Drawing course; Meetup lists Art Models and Photoshoot in Sydney for model-based sessions.
Sydney Community College runs a two-session Urban Sketching drawing course.
Sydney Community College lists beginners watercolour painting and watercolour and sketching courses, including botanical art.
Sydney Community College lists an Oil Painting Course in its painting program.
Sydney Community College runs a two-day Bookbinding Course for Beginners.
Sydney Community College runs a one-evening Candle Making Workshop.
Sydney Community College runs a Precious Metal Clay silver jewellery course (clay-based rather than traditional silversmithing).
Sydney Community College runs a Crochet Course for Beginners over four Saturdays.
Sydney Community College runs a Learn to DJ beginners course.
Sydney Community College runs Guitar Lessons for Beginners.
Sydney Community College runs piano lessons for beginners (levels 1-3) and continuers.
Sydney Philharmonia Choirs runs community choirs open to everyone (Festival Chorus, ChorusOz, Christmas Choir) and Sydney Community College runs a choir.
Taikoz has a home dojo in Ultimo and runs beginner to advanced taiko classes, kids and teens classes and workshops.
Sydney Community College runs 8-week Adult Ballet Classes for Beginners at Saint John's Church Hall, Birchgrove.
venue: Saint John's Church Hall (Sydney Community College)

how: Sydney Community College runs a leadlight Stained Glass Course for Beginners in Rozelle plus a glass fusing workshop.
Sydney Community College runs a Stand-up Comedy Course for Beginners taught by a working comedian.
Sydney Community College runs hand-stitch workshops (Textile Collage and Slow Stitch, beading and appliqué) in Rozelle; no dedicated embroidery course was listed.
Tropical Soul Dance Studio (Stanmore) runs beginner salsa and bachata classes and Australia Hall (Surry Hills) hosts Sydney salsa classes.
Sydney Tango Collective runs free and regular Argentine tango classes in Paddington.
Improv classes and shows run at The Chippo Hotel (Chippendale), The Abercrombie Hotel (Broadway) and Newtown Neighbourhood Centre, including a free improv class.
A 10-week mixing and recording course runs at Redfern Community Centre, and the Academy of Music and Performing Arts (Surry Hills) teaches music production.
Achieve Pole Studio in Rosebery runs pole dance classes and competitions.
Airmazing Studio in North Sydney is an aerial arts studio that hosts aerial events and classes.
Bondi Beach (about 7 km east of the CBD) has a surfboard-riding zone at its south end, and Bondi and North Bondi surf life saving clubs; surf schools operate on Sydney beaches.
Sydney Amateur Sailing Club (Cremorne Point, est. 1872) runs racing and events on the harbour; Royal Sydney Yacht Squadron (Kirribilli) is a members-only club.
Royal Sydney Yacht Squadron (Kirribilli) runs a Youth Sailing program in Laser, Optimist and Pacer dinghies; it is a private members club.
Sydney Amateur Sailing Club (Cremorne Point) members race keelboat yachts on Sydney Harbour, including Sydney to Hobart entrants.
Centennial Parklands has equestrian schools and a dirt horse-riding track on Grand Drive.
Hang gliding and paragliding are flown from Bald Hill at Stanwell Park, about 59 km south of Sydney; no site was found within the metro area.
Buzkashi is played on the Central Asian steppe (Afghanistan, Tajikistan, Kazakhstan); no horse-and-carcass buzkashi exists in Australia.
Camel racing is held in outback Australia (the Camel Cup at Alice Springs, the Boulia Camel Races in Queensland), more than 2,000 km from Sydney; no regular races within the metro area.

Elephant polo needs working elephants and is played in Thailand, Nepal and India; Australia has no suitable animals.
No ski-jumping hill exists in Australia; the nearest hills are in Japan and Europe.
No snow in the Sydney metro area; snow sculpting is possible only in the Snowy Mountains (Perisher or Thredbo, roughly 5-6 hours by road) in winter.
No snow in the Sydney metro area; the nearest snowboarding is in the Snowy Mountains (Perisher or Thredbo, roughly 5-6 hours by road) in winter.
Sydney Trail Series (since 2013) runs trail races at St Ives / Ku-ring-gai Chase and Manly Dam / Garigal National Park for all abilities including first-timers.
DSA Dragon Boat Club at Meadowbank and Rowers On Cooks River (Wolli Creek) run come-and-try dragon boating sessions.
Guided bird walks, bushfood walks and forest therapy walks run in Royal National Park, Lucas Heights, Nielsen Park and other reserves; Sydney Harbour National Park lists guided bushwalking tours.
venue: Royal National Park / Sydney Harbour National Park

how: Swing Patrol lists Sydney as one of its locations, teaching swing and Lindy hop classes.
A Leather Journal Making Workshop runs at Woolloomooloo on a recurring weekly schedule.
DIY CRAFTS in South Penrith runs a recurring Perfume Making Workshop.
Hurstville Museum and Gallery runs a drypoint etching for beginners workshop (an intaglio technique), listed as sold out.
Hurstville Museum and Gallery runs a printmaking open art room on Saturdays; no dedicated screenprinting class was found.
A multi-date Chinese calligraphy workshop is listed at Darling Square Community Bank branch, Haymarket.
Taekwondo open training sessions run at Ultimo Public School and a free kids class at Guildford Community Centre.
